newsitem.title: INDIA: India Kopran not to convert warrants.
newsitem.headline: India Kopran not to convert warrants.

text.p: Indian pharmaceutical firm Kopran Ltd said its promoters and associates decided not to convert their warrants into equities.

"Kopran had issued to its promoters and their associates three million warrants. Each warrant carried the right to be coverted into one equity share at a price of 240 rupees on or before May 1997," the company said in a statement on Wednesday.
It said the promoters of Kopran decided not to exercise their right. The statement did not give any reasons.
"Hence the company's paid-up equity capital will stand unchanged at 143 million rupees," it said.
Kopran is a leading producer and exporter of amoxycillin, a penicillin-based antibiotic.
